name: Chen Long
bio: Chen Long is an actor in Mainland China and an actor in the Shanghai Film Actors Troupe.

credits.title: The Real Monkey King: Bufashan
credits.overview: At the mysterious Bufa Mountain inn where no one can use magic, strangers; some from the Western Regions converge with hidden motives. A Journey to the West-style “werewolf game” unfolds as even the monk’s party hides their identities.

credits.title: Shanghai Wonton
credits.overview: The film tells the story of a retired father who comes to the park's dating corner to find a marriage partner for his son, but inadvertently gets involved in an emotional whirlpool.
Tells the story of a Communist Party's early history during the turbulent era, examining the remarkable Chinese revolutionary leaders' zeal and contrition for the ascension of the Chinese people.

credits.title: The Sixteenth Level of Hell
credits.overview: A female journalist meets an armed robber, she chooses not to call the police, but contacts him, and when the female reporter communicates heart-to-heart with the robber, the armed robber makes a decision that will affect his life.

credits.title: The Climbers
credits.overview: Upon learning that the international community does not recognize China's ascent of Mount Everest during May 1960 owing to a lack of videographic evidence from the summit, three members on the team rally together a group of young hopefuls to reach the world's highest point.
